cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to listen for the feeling, not just the facts. You missed my concert; what did that empty seat feel like to me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accurate. You always get the timetable right. Try the part where I kept looking for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. You saw me look at the door before the encore. Tell me you understand why I couldn't enjoy that song; don't just give me the first feeling word you learned.

reason: Make the final pupil request seek acknowledgment of the lost enjoyment caused by waiting, rather than only asking which event A hoped would happen.
